scripts.dev: npm run build -w @flowledger/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowledger/shared && npm run build -w @flowledger/api && npm run build -w @flowledger/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flowledger/shared && npm run test -w @flowledger/api && npm run test -w @flowledger/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @flowledger/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flowledger/api && npm run typecheck -w @flowledger/web
